name: ue-engineering-paradigm
description: An opinionated architecture skill for Unreal Engine: where each thing goes across C++, Blueprint and data, and why. GAS abilities as Blueprint chains of C++ nodes, the Blueprint node contract, data assets and validation, content velocity, composition over god classes, and the CDO/replication traps. Plus skills for working with AI agents on an Unreal project: lanes and worktrees, briefs and reports, the visual review loop, and procedural content fixtures.
